title: Katherine Charter Fishing

services.name: Charter Info
services.desc: Our goal is to ensure you have a safe, enjoyable trip and that you will want to return. We offer full and half day trips aboard clean and well maintained boats. The Katherine is Coast Guard certified for 22 people. The Katherine II is Coast Guard certified for 30 people. Corporate trips welcome, if you need more boats we can arrange it for you. We invite groups of all ages and ability. All licenses and tackle are provided and included. Just bring your food and drink. Alcohol is allowed, cans preferred. Smoking is permitted on deck but not in cabin. You are also welcome to bring your rod-n-reel and tackle if you like. We fish in numerous spots including Dundalk, Deale, Chesapeake Beach and
